fields.description: ISO 3166-2 region code (for example "FR" for France) of the region where the ad was shown, or a text representation of an aggregate region (for example "EEA" for the European Economic Area)
fields.name: region_code

fields.description: YYYY-MM-DD representation of the first date the ad was shown. If the ad was first shown before March 1st, 2023, March 1st, 2023 will be reported as the first_shown date.
fields.name: first_shown

fields.description: YYYY-MM-DD representation of the last date the ad was shown
fields.name: last_shown

fields.description: YYYY-MM-DD representation of the date up to which times_shown (both upper and lower bounds) has been updated. This field is NULL if no impressions occurred within the reporting period.
fields.name: times_shown_end_date

fields.description: The lower bound of the number of times the ad was shown in the associated region. This field is NULL if no impressions occurred within the reporting period.
fields.name: times_shown_lower_bound

fields.description: The upper bound of the number of times the ad was shown in the associated region. This field is NULL if no impressions occurred within the valid reporting period.
fields.name: times_shown_upper_bound

fields.description: YYYY-MM-DD representation of the earliest date for which times_shown is considered (both upper and lower bounds). Impressions are reported for activity since March 1st, 2023. This field is NULL if no impressions occurred with the reporting period.
fields.name: times_shown_start_date

fields.description: YYYY-MM-DD representation of the date on which impressions will become available if no impressions occurred within the reporting period. This field is NULL if impressions did occur within the reporting period.
fields.name: times_shown_availability_date

fields.description: Collection of platforms where the ad served and their relevant serving times lower/upper bound. This field is NULL if no platform serving stats data is populated.
Collection of platforms where the ad served and their relevant serving times lower/upper bound. The field is empty if no platform serving stats data is available within the valid reporting period.
The platform where the ad served. Possible values are: SEARCH, MAPS, PLAY, SHOPPING, YOUTUBE.
fields.name: surface

fields.description: The upper bound of the number of times the ad was shown in the associated region and platform.
fields.name: times_shown_upper_bound

fields.description: The lower bound of the number of times the ad was shown in the associated region and platform.
fields.name: times_shown_lower_bound
surface_serving_stats
surface_serving_stats

schema.name: region_stats

schema.description: Information on audience selection, broken out by approach type. The available values are: "CRITERIA_INCLUDED" (Criteria from this category were included in the ad's audience), "CRITERIA_EXCLUDED" (Criteria from this category were excluded from the ad's audience), "CRITERIA_INCLUDED_AND_EXCLUDED" (Some criteria from this category were included and others were excluded from the ad's audience), and "CRITERIA_UNUSED" (Criteria from these categories were not used for audience selection).

fields.description: Describes if and how demographic info was used to select the ad audience (see audience_selection_approach_info above for more details)
fields.name: demographic_info

fields.description: Describes if and how geo location info was used to select the ad audience (see audience_selection_approach_info above for more details)
fields.name: geo_location

fields.description: Describes if and how contextual signals were used to select the ad audience (see audience_selection_approach_info above for more details)
fields.name: contextual_signals

fields.description: Describes if and how customer lists were used to select the ad audience (see audience_selection_approach_info above for more details)
fields.name: customer_lists

fields.description: Describes if and how topics of interest were used to select the ad audience (see audience_selection_approach_info above for more details)
fields.name: topics_of_interest

schema.name: audience_selection_approach_info

schema.description: Indicates whether the ad is funded by an in-kind donation through Google Ad Grants. This field is set to true if the advertiser is a recipient of a Google Ad Grants in-kind donation. Google ad Grants donates Search advertising to eligible organizations. Google does not endorse these ad.
schema.name: is_funded_by_google_ad_grants

schema.description: The payer of the ad when different from the advertiser's disclosed name
schema.name: ad_funded_by
